regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. Many thanks for your charitable favor of Dec. 12th. Only To-day did I get to note down the names. It's now five:30 and I baraly know how often I've started with this little note since 9:30 a.m. I wanted also to send the cards: but then I thought probably you would not use them anyhow. So I am sending you blanks in case you wish them.
